Description: As a new reader, I want to securely register with unique username and email so that my account credentials and personal data are protected.
As a registered user, I want to authenticate using bcrypt-hashed credentials and terminate sessions cleanly on logout so that unauthorized sessions cannot be replayed.
As a reader, I want to search books by title keyword, author, and genre so that I can discover books without SQL injection risk.

Summary: Book Details and Dynamic Rating Aggregation
Description: As a reader, I want to view book details with calculated average star ratings and community review counts so that I can evaluate reading choices.
As a reader, I want to submit a 1 to 5 star rating and review body with unique per-user constraint so that I can share feedback.

Summary: Edit and Delete Own Reviews (IDOR Prevention)
Description: As a review author, I want to edit or delete my own review while preventing any other user from modifying or removing it via IDOR attacks.
As a reader, I want to maintain a private shelf with statuses (want-to-read, reading, finished) isolated strictly to my account.
As an administrator, I want to add, edit, and delete books in the catalog protected by server-side @admin_required authorization.
As an administrator, I want to hide or restore inappropriate reviews with mandatory reason logging so that community safety is preserved.

Summary: Security Audit Logging with Secret Scrubbing
Description: As a security auditor, I want all sensitive authentication and moderation events logged immutably with credentials scrubbed.
As a DevSecOps engineer, I want the platform packaged in a non-root multi-stage Docker container with /health liveness probes.

Summary: Automated CI/CD Pipeline and SAST Scans
Description: As a DevSecOps engineer, I want automated unit tests and Bandit SAST security scans running on every commit.
